title: Tight Bounds for Non-Monotone Submodular Maximization under a Cardinality Constraint with Constant Recourse
abstract: arXiv:2611.20257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the maximization of a nonnegative submodular function under a cardinality constraint when elements arrive one at a time and an algorithm must report a feasible set after every arrival. The recourse of an algorithm is the largest number of insertions and deletions that it makes to the reported set at a single arrival. For every $\epsilon>0$, we give an algorithm with recourse $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ whose reported set has, at every time, expected value at least $1/4-\epsilon$ times the largest value of a feasible set of arrived elements. The algorithm evaluates the function polynomially often, and only on sets of arrived elements. We also show that no algorithm with constant recourse achieves a ratio above $1/4$, even if it knows the function and the arrival order in advance and has unlimited computation, and that any fixed ratio above $1/4$ requires recourse that grows as a positive power of the cardinality budget. translated_title: 常数调整代价下基数约束非单调次模函数最大化的紧致界
translated_abstract: 我们研究在基数约束下最大化非负次模函数的问题，其中元素逐个到达，且算法必须在每次元素到达后报告一个可行集合。算法的调整代价是指它在单次元素到达时对所报告集合进行的插入和删除操作的最大次数。对于任意 ε>0，我们提出了一个调整代价为 O(ε^{-2}) 的算法，其报告的集合在任意时刻的期望值至少是已到达元素中最大可行集值的 1/4−ε 倍。该算法对函数进行多项式次数的求值，且仅对已到达元素构成的集合进行求值。我们还证明了任何具有常数调整代价的算法都无法取得高于 1/4 的近似比，即使该算法事先知晓函数和元素到达顺序并拥有无限的计算能力；此外，要达到任何固定的高于 1/4 的比率，所需的调整代价必须随基数预算呈正数次幂增长。因此 1/4 是该问题的紧致界。
tldr: 本文提出了一个调整代价为 O(ε^{-2}) 的算法，在元素在线到达的设定下以 1/4−ε 的近似比解决基数约束下的非单调次模函数最大化问题，并证明 1/4 是常数调整代价算法的紧致上界。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an algorithm with recourse O(ε^{-2}) that achieves a 1/4−ε approximation for online non-monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint, and proves that 1/4 is the tight upper bound for constant-recourse algorithms.
